description: Defines the MediaType class for managing media type configuration entities in Drupal, including properties, plugin collections, and access control.

classes.name: MediaType
classes.description: Represents a media type configuration entity in Drupal, managing properties like ID, label, description, source, status, revision, source configuration, and field mappings.

methods.name: getPluginCollections
methods.description: Returns plugin collections, specifically the source configuration collection.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the media type.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the media type.

methods.name: thumbnailDownloadsAreQueued
methods.description: Checks if thumbnail downloads are queued.

methods.name: setQueueThumbnailDownloadsStatus
methods.description: Sets the queue status for thumbnail downloads.

methods.name: sourcePluginCollection
methods.description: Returns the lazy plugin collection for the media source.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the media type is active.

methods.name: shouldCreateNewRevision
methods.description: Checks if new revisions should be created.
